name: Crunch
summary: A basic floor exercise that flexes the spine to train the rectus abdominis through a short range of motion.
setup: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place the fingertips lightly behind the head or cross the arms on your chest.
Press the lower back gently toward the floor and brace the abs.
execution: Curl the head, neck and shoulder blades off the floor using your abs.
Pause briefly at the top with the ribs drawn toward the pelvis.
Lower back down slowly under control.
Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
cues: Do not pull on the neck
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands: keep the fingertips light and look up at the ceiling.
Using momentum: slow down and control both directions.
Sitting up too high: lift only the shoulder blades off the floor.
Holding the breath: exhale on the way up.
